facts.t: Established 2003, 470 ha in central Tuamasaga, Upolu, with three volcanic crater lakes: Lanoto'o, Lanoata'ata, Lanoanea
Ramsar wetland of international importance since 2004
Reached by cross-island road south from Apia then 4WD and a walk; goldfish thrive in the lake; rare swamp forest

facts.t: Secluded island off Upolu's eastern tip, within the reef
Boat leaves from the mainland a few minutes' drive from Lalomanu Beach
Turtles often spotted on the short boat trip; beach fales on the island

In Letolo Plantation, Palauli district, east Savai'i
Base 60 m by 50 m, 12 m tall, near Olemoe Falls
